author: Sixth Front
description: A battle type: pick NAVAL on the main menu, then a map (Sapphire Strait, Iron Harbor, Arctic Passage) and a mode (Conquest, Fleet Battle, Strike). Everyone commands a warship: cruisers (Ticonderoga / Slava), destroyers (Arleigh Burke / Sovremenny), frigates (Constellation / Grigorovich), corvettes (Freedom LCS / Buyan-M) and patrol boats. Guns elevate by themselves to land where you aim (G switches HE and AP shells), missiles need a lock, torpedoes run straight. Hits start fires, flood compartments and knock out the engine, the rudder or the guns: R calls the damage control party. The bigger ships carry Phalanx CIWS guns that shoot down incoming missiles with a roar of tracers.
